entries.reason: Compose native generic/GitHub/Gitea authentication, normalization and event notices with per-trigger schedule credentials and one supervised profile listener.
entries.contract: D10 opt-in nonwildcard binding, unique durable receipt per delivery before effects, scoped scheduler admission and schedule-conversation publication; native responses and identical-body redelivery under D17.
entries.invariant: No management/chat/control routes, body deduplication, freshness/rate/TLS gates, automatic interrupted handoff replay, or payload-derived tool authority.

entries.reason: Replace the unimplemented global inbound credential with explicit owner-selected bind settings and per-schedule source/keyring credential leaves.
entries.contract: Ingress remains off by default and cannot bind a wildcard; bounded schedule identifiers map independent trigger secrets through existing settings/secrets methods.
entries.invariant: No imported server listener or global credential can widen a trigger's candidate set; unrelated schema behavior remains retained.

entries.reason: Describe inbound webhook desired state as live-read by the actual supervised ingress owner rather than an unimplemented boot-only listener.
entries.contract: Configuration changes are adopted by ingress reconciliation without a live-service restart or new transport API.
entries.invariant: Secret sensitivity, settings transaction semantics and outbound owner behavior remain unchanged.

entries.reason: Compose the inbound receiver after real schedule/settings/storage owners and close it before profile storage during supervised shutdown.
entries.contract: One core lifetime owns listener, admission and durable event publication; parent EOF closes actual ephemeral ingress and its pending work.
entries.invariant: No daemon, extra owner/executor, active-desktop interaction, or remote management capability.

entries.reason: Project actual ingress availability and bound address through the existing bounded status summary.
entries.contract: Status distinguishes disabled/unconfigured/no-eligible/not-bound/accepting, never promising an externally reachable endpoint.
entries.invariant: No secret, raw payload, transcript or invented listener readiness is exposed.

entries.reason: Reconcile the real receiver after authenticated schedule CRUD without altering retained schedule action validation.
entries.contract: Removing/pausing the last eligible trigger closes admission, and retained stored conversation destinations remain authoritative.
entries.invariant: No supplied requester identity, cross-schedule credential dispatch, or alternate schedule executor.

entries.reason: Register exact inbound receipt columns for supported profile reopen and interrupted delivery recovery.
entries.contract: Receipt persistence is part of the same profile journal identity and schema validator.
entries.invariant: Unknown tables/columns or foreign-profile stores still refuse adoption; no weakening of storage validation.

entries.reason: Notify the actual ingress owner after existing transactional settings, keyring secret and reload operations settle.
entries.contract: Configuration remains durable before adoption; secrets remain in the profile vault and revocation is checked again immediately before dispatch.
entries.invariant: No new management protocol, plaintext credential persistence or bypass of shared settings locks.

entries.reason: Add an optional core-owned candidate and admission callback to retained trigger reservation/dispatch under the existing scheduler lock.
entries.contract: Only the authenticated trigger's schedule can be admitted, with current generation/config checks before effects and retained AND matching/in-flight exclusion.
entries.invariant: Unscoped inherited callers retain their behavior; no new executor, uncertain-effect retry, overlap backlog, or payload replacement of stored tool inputs.

entries.reason: Seal and project exactly named safe inherited auth/event/scheduler and YAML utility assertions from the immutable archive.
entries.contract: Original assertions, decorators, signatures and parameter data are preserved before exact selection; only the removed GitHub factory setup is bridged to genuine Desktop owners.
entries.invariant: Partial mixed-suite selections are not full restoration, and prohibited inputs/removed management surfaces are never executed or replaced with fabricated pass evidence.

entries.reason: Bridge inherited GitHub fixture construction to real temporary profile stores, scheduler and actual delivery-only ingress.
entries.contract: Legacy callbacks observe committed transcript readback rather than implementing fake delivery or request authority.
entries.invariant: Ephemeral loopback only; no HealthServer management emulation, LAN exposure, real keyring or active desktop.

entries.reason: Execute the exact selected inherited corpus with independent source/AST seals and real private-profile integration checks.
entries.contract: Selected auth/message/matching/persistence behavior runs behind the sanitized PID namespace and remains distinguishable from new receiver proofs.
entries.invariant: Frozen corpus bytes are unchanged, partial suites remain explicit, and no unsafe native/lifecycle/management test is admitted.

entries.reason: Exercise actual receipt durability, duplicate redelivery, scoped authentication, revocation, parsing/body limits and supervised parent-loss cleanup.
entries.contract: Real temporary profiles and ephemeral loopback listeners prove the new composition; no document-only assertion substitutes for behavior.
entries.invariant: No live config, LAN exposure, active desktop, external effect, or automatic uncertain-run replay.
